text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for interrupting you in the
middle of a
meeting. About the damage
to the inferior...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah... Last night, I had a drink to
kick-start
my thoughts... and drank too
much coffee.
choice_data_list_en: The downside of being an intellectual...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The label said something like "Feel alert
and say
goodbye to drowsiness." But I
never imagined it'd
be so effective as to
keep me awake so long...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... You should be careful with coffee as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just one cup had this effect... I'll... have
only half
a cup today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to her guileless personality,
Sakura
Bakushin O suffers from insomnia
after drinking
just a single cup of
coffee...
